name: Gakuen Hyouryuu Senki
source:
April 2005. Main character is a high school student on a voyage trip with a lot of his girl classmates. He's been in love with his classmate Suzuki Kaori for a long time and now is a perfect opportunity to finally confess. But after an incident Main character wakes up alone at a beach shore. What will he do now?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2005年4月。主角是一名高中生，正與許多女同學一起參加海上旅行。他一直暗戀著同班同學Suzuki Kaori，現在終於等到了向她告白的好機會。然而，一場意外發生後，主角醒來時發現自己孤身一人躺在海灘上。他接下來該怎麼辦？

（來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]）
